answer: The toll does the work that no ban list ever could. Each name is charged 95 separate visits, each one billed £49 at the door, and the charges stack up faster than the rewards do. The desk only stamps a name that carries Sanctioned juror gathering warrant, and the stamp itself rests on a warrant jurors show after oath trials. The ledger counts names, not wishes, and every name on it has paid its own way. oasis is written on the receipt. The clerk notes vault. The echo is checked, not assumed.
